remarks: Opportunity knocks in Stamford's Waterside neighborhood! This three-bedroom, three-bathroom Cape offers incredible potential for buyers looking to customize their dream home or invest in a rewarding renovation project.  Inside, you'll find generously sized bedrooms-a rare find in homes of this style-along with the convenience of a full bathroom on every level, providing flexibility for guests, multi-generational living, or future layout reconfigurations.  Key mechanical updates offer peace of mind, including a newer roof, water heater, and furnace, allowing you to focus your vision on cosmetic and interior upgrades.  The exterior truly shines with a spacious attached one-car garage, a large deck perfect for entertaining or relaxing, and a deep backyard offering endless possibilities for outdoor living, gardening, or expansion.  Located just minutes from beaches, parks, transportation, and all that downtown Stamford has to offer, this property is a rare chance to create value in a sought-after location.  Bring your ideas and unlock the full potential of this Waterside gem!
